actualFreshPrimaryReading.title: HGB §105
actualFreshPrimaryReading.actualReading: Whole paragraphs1–3 directly retrieved and actually read
actualFreshPrimaryReading.boundedOwnParaphraseAndCaseUse: OHG combines a shared commercial undertaking with unlimited partner liability; it can independently hold rights and debts. The given cases explicitly supply formation conditions, not personal founding advice.

actualFreshPrimaryReading.title: HGB §126
actualFreshPrimaryReading.actualReading: Whole norm directly retrieved and actually read
actualFreshPrimaryReading.boundedOwnParaphraseAndCaseUse: Partners are personally jointly liable; a contrary internal agreement cannot bind creditors. The model distinguishes this from company-only exposure.

actualFreshPrimaryReading.title: GmbHG §13
actualFreshPrimaryReading.actualReading: Whole paragraphs1–3 directly retrieved and actually read, prior first attempt timeout preserved as reading history
actualFreshPrimaryReading.boundedOwnParaphraseAndCaseUse: The company owns its rights and obligations, and company assets answer for its debts. That does not guarantee shareholders retain their investment or eliminate a separately effective guarantee.

actualFreshPrimaryReading.title: LkSG §1
actualFreshPrimaryReading.actualReading: Whole paragraphs1–3 directly retrieved and actually read
actualFreshPrimaryReading.boundedOwnParaphraseAndCaseUse: The domestic employee threshold became1000 in2024; group and agency-worker counting can matter. The fictional supplied conditions explicitly exclude such exceptions; A1500 and B100 are not assigned identical scope.

actualFreshPrimaryReading.title: LkSG §3
actualFreshPrimaryReading.actualReading: Whole paragraphs1–3 directly retrieved and actually read
actualFreshPrimaryReading.boundedOwnParaphraseAndCaseUse: Due diligence is proportionate to activity, influence, severity and contribution. Risk, prevention, remedy and complaint duties differ from guaranteed outcomes. The statute itself creates no new civil liability and preserves independently grounded liability.

actualFreshPrimaryReading.title: LkSG §4
actualFreshPrimaryReading.actualReading: Whole paragraphs1–4 directly retrieved and actually read
actualFreshPrimaryReading.boundedOwnParaphraseAndCaseUse: Effective risk management enters real operating procedures, names responsible oversight and accounts for affected people. A paper committee or funded promise alone is not implemented protection.

actualFreshPrimaryReading.title: LkSG §6
actualFreshPrimaryReading.actualReading: Direct open timeout; targeted official indexed whole paragraphs1–5 actually retrieved and read; no successful direct-GET or whole-PDF claim
actualFreshPrimaryReading.boundedOwnParaphraseAndCaseUse: A priority-risk policy is followed by appropriate purchasing, training, supplier assurances and controls, with annual/triggered effectiveness review. A signed code alone is not all these actions.

actualFreshPrimaryReading.title: LkSG §7
actualFreshPrimaryReading.actualReading: Whole paragraphs1–4 directly retrieved and actually read
actualFreshPrimaryReading.boundedOwnParaphraseAndCaseUse: Remedy starts promptly. A supplier harm not soon stoppable requires an implemented timed concept. Required termination has cumulative severity, failed deadline and no milder/influence options; harm alone does not establish it.

actualFreshPrimaryReading.title: LkSG §8
actualFreshPrimaryReading.actualReading: Whole paragraphs1–5 directly retrieved and actually read
actualFreshPrimaryReading.boundedOwnParaphraseAndCaseUse: Complaints need accessible rules, independent confidential handling and protection against retaliation, with periodic/triggered review. The material correctly requires genuine worker access rather than mere favourable branding.
